description: The TileLang vocabulary head tests of vLLM patch 0036, from the candidate image's own vLLM tree: the packed BF16 head against an FP32 reference (exceptions included, and none), bit-identical logits across token tiles, step widths, pipeline depths and batch sizes; BF16 heads likewise; the logits processor projecting prepared heads. Then the earlier TileLang router and BF16 projection tests.
